thread:
marta: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR for audit-log retention language and a small SDK example migration. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 :eyes:
pranav: Thanks! Do you mean the SOC2 section or the API reference?
marta: Both — SOC2 guidance wording + the python + curl snippets under "audit exports". Want legal to review the phrasing about TTLs and pseudonymization.
kelly: skimmed the PR, the code examples look fine but we should avoid implying exact retention windows for all customers. Maybe show a sample TTL and say "typical ranges".
olivia-legal: agreed with kelly. Suggest we change "we retain audit logs for 90 days" -> "we retain audit logs according to customer configuration and applicable legal requirements (typical retention ranges: 30–365 days)". Also add a sentence about legal holds.
pranav: wording suggestion looks good. Can we also add a tiny SDK snippet to show redaction filter usage? Something like:
```
# python example: filter PII when exporting
from redwood import AuditExport
exporter = AuditExport(api_key=REDWOOD_API_KEY)
exporter.export(filter={"redact": ["email","ssn"]}, retention_days=90)
```
marta: I wrote a shorter sample in the PR but will swap for that. We should keep it clear it's illustrative only.
kelly: tiny nit — in the curl example we reference "--ttl" flag which doesn't exist on the export CLI. Use "--retention-days" instead.
marta: good catch, updating now.
ci-bot: build passed for docs PR #812 (links check OK) :white_check_mark:
olivia-legal: also request: remove the exact phrase "SOC2-compliant retention default". Compliance depends on customer config and our controls; we can say "designed to support SOC2 evidence collection when configured".
pranav: can you paste the final sentence you want, olivia, and we'll put it verbatim?
olivia-legal: sure: "Redwood provides configurable retention controls and audit export features designed to support SOC2 evidence collection; customers are responsible for selecting retention parameters that meet their obligations."
marta: pasted and pushed. Updated curl flag and added explicit redaction example with a comment that it's illustrative.
kelly: quick read — looks good. One more UX note: add a link to the retention policy policy page (internal) and mark the SDK snippet as "beta" (we've had API changes).
marta: added link and beta badge.
ci-bot: docs link-checker: external link to https://compliance.example.com/retention-policy returned 200.
olivia-legal: thanks — approving wording from legal. :thumbsup:
marta: awesome, I'll merge after one more review from eng and then create a short release note for the docs changelog. Thanks all! :clap:
summary: Coordination thread for docs PR updating SOC2/retention wording and SDK/curl examples; legal requested softer phrasing and illustrative snippets; CI checks passed; ready to merge after minor fixes.
